title.en: Auctions: bidding and telling the truth

description.zh: 第一价格拍卖要压价，第二价格拍卖里说真话是占优策略；英式与第二价格等价、荷式与第一价格等价，平均收益相等；真值不确定时出现赢家的诅咒。单件物品、对称风险中性竞标者的模型。
description.en: First-price auctions call for shading, truth-telling is dominant in second-price auctions, English matches second price and Dutch matches first price, and average revenue is equal; with an uncertain true value the winner’s curse appears. A single-item model with symmetric risk-neutral bidders.

reason.zh: 第二价格拍卖里，无论对手怎么报，说真话都不比别的报价差，是占优策略的一个具体例子。
reason.en: In a second-price auction, telling the truth is never worse than any other bid whatever the rival does, a concrete dominant strategy.

label.zh: 用随机抽样验证收益相等

reason.zh: 多轮随机抽取估值并累计平均，两种规则的平均收益靠近同一个理论值，这是蒙特卡洛估计的直接应用。
reason.en: Drawing values at random over many rounds and averaging brings both rules to the same theoretical value, a direct use of Monte Carlo estimation.

title.zh: 怎样的拍卖规则能让人说真话？
title.en: Which auction rule makes people bid truthfully?

ask.zh: 第一价格拍卖里，为什么中标者总想压一点价？第二价格里，说出真实估值会亏吗？
ask.en: In a first-price auction, why does the winner always want to shade the bid a little? In a second-price auction, can telling your true value lose you money?

ask.zh: “占优策略”是什么意思？为什么第二价格里的真话策略不用猜对手出什么？
ask.en: What does a “dominant strategy” mean? Why does truth-telling in second-price need no guess about rivals?

reveal.zh: 第二价格拍卖里，说真话是占优策略：出价只决定你是否中标，不决定你付多少钱，付的是第二高价；第一价格里中标即按自己出价付款，所以人人压价。英式等价于第二价格、荷式等价于第一价格，平均收益相等；真值不确定时还要小心赢家的诅咒。
reveal.en: In a second-price auction truth-telling is dominant: your bid only decides whether you win, not what you pay — you pay the second-highest bid. In a first-price auction you pay your own bid when you win, so everyone shades; English matches second-price and Dutch matches first-price with equal average revenue, and with uncertain true values, beware the winner's curse.
